newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Demand good for S.African equity options seats.
newsitem.headline: Demand good for S.African equity options seats.

text.p: There has been good demand for seats on South Africa's planned Equity Options Market as the deadline for applying for a place ends on Friday, a Johannesburg Stock Exchange spokeswoman said.
"It has been a reasonably good response," she said.
The applications for 75 seats on the market -- to be known as EOM -- will now be presented to the Johannesburg Stock Exchange's (JSE) executive committee and a statement will be made on Monday.
EOM is planned for launch in October and will list standardised American style scrip-settled call and put options on the equities underlying the ALSI40, GLDI10, INDI25 and FINDI30 indices.
This will provide traded options on around 50 blue chip stocks.
Trading is to be initially conducted on a screen and telephone basis before moving to an automated system at a later date.
The seats cost 85,000 rand each and industry sources said some financial insitutions had asked for an extension to the deadline as they were still considering whether to join the market.
The issue is to be considered at the executive committee meeting on Monday, the sources said.
